title: Tim Cook's Final Keynote Is on Monday. Apple Is Betting Everything on AI It Can Run on Your Phone.
excerpt: WWDC 2026 will unveil a Siri overhaul powered by Google's Gemini, an edge-AI strategy that prioritises on-device processing, and a bill-splitting feature in Apple Wallet. It is also the last major stage for the CEO who turned Apple into a $3 trillion company.
body:
When Tim Cook takes the stage at Apple Park on Monday for the opening keynote of WWDC 2026, it will almost certainly be his last. The 65-year-old CEO is set to hand the title to hardware chief John Ternus in September, capping a tenure that transformed Apple from a phone company into the most valuable corporation on the planet. What he unveils on June 8 will define how he wants to be remembered on artificial intelligence, the technology he spent years being accused of ignoring.

The stakes are not hypothetical. Apple shares have climbed 17 percent in May alone, pushing the company back to the second-largest US market capitalisation behind Microsoft. Shareholders are expecting the AI payoff they have been promised since Apple Intelligence was first announced in 2024. UBS analyst David Vogt is not convinced, reiterating a Neutral rating with a $296 price target and warning that the event is "unlikely to drive demand absent a surprise."

Cook and his team appear to disagree.

## The Siri Overhaul

The centrepiece of WWDC 2026 is Siri 2.0, the long-awaited overhaul of Apple's voice assistant that has been in development for over two years. According to people familiar with Apple's plans, the new Siri will be able to hold multi-turn conversations, understand on-screen context, chain actions across multiple apps, and perform tasks that currently require users to tap through several menus manually.

The upgrade is powered by a partnership with Google. Apple has agreed to use a large version of Google's Gemini model to train a smaller, distilled version capable of running locally on Apple hardware. The arrangement represents a departure from Apple's original Apple Intelligence announcement, which promised that all cloud-bound queries would be handled exclusively by Apple's own Private Cloud Compute infrastructure running on Apple silicon.

For cloud processing that cannot be handled on-device, Apple has approved the use of Nvidia's confidential compute technology within Google Cloud. The security feature encrypts data and AI models during processing, adding a modest performance cost but offering the kind of privacy protections Apple's customers expect. Apple is likely to retain the Private Cloud Compute branding despite the architectural shift.

## Edge AI as a Competitive Moat

Apple's pitch is not that it has the best AI models. It is that it has the best chips to run AI models locally, without sending data to the cloud. The company plans to position on-device inference as a privacy-preserving, cost-saving alternative to the massive data centre buildouts that rivals like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google have pursued.

This is a direct play for the Indian market, where Apple has been aggressively expanding its retail and manufacturing presence. India's 1.4 billion smartphone users are price-conscious about data plans and increasingly wary of cloud privacy. An AI assistant that works offline, or at least minimises cloud dependency, could be a meaningful differentiator in a market where Apple is still fighting for share against Android.

Apple is also reportedly scouting acquisitions to advance its model-shrinking capabilities, with one target being Liquid AI, a Massachusetts startup focused on efficient on-device AI inference.

## What Else to Expect

Beyond Siri, WWDC 2026 is expected to introduce iOS 27 with several consumer-facing features that will matter to the 1.5 billion people who use Apple devices daily. A new Visual Intelligence mode in the Camera app will use Google Image Search to identify objects in real time. The Photos app will gain AI-powered editing tools, including the ability to request edits using natural language and an Extend feature that generates scenery beyond the original frame of a photo.

Apple Wallet is getting a bill-splitting feature that lets users photograph a receipt and generate payment requests, along with a Create a Pass option for digitising physical tickets and membership cards. Image Playground, Apple's image generation app, will receive higher-quality output and a simplified interface.

## The Diaspora Angle

For the estimated 300,000 Indian-origin engineers working in Silicon Valley, many of them at Apple itself, WWDC is not just a product event. It is a career barometer. Apple's AI strategy will determine hiring priorities, team structures, and visa sponsorship patterns for years to come. The company's growing emphasis on on-device AI and custom silicon means demand for chip designers, ML compression specialists, and embedded systems engineers, roles where Indian tech talent is disproportionately represented.

The conference runs from June 8 to 12 at Apple Park in Cupertino. The keynote begins at 10 AM Pacific Time and will be streamed live on Apple's website and YouTube channel.
